versions.changelog: Initial release: add a home dashboard widget that rediscovers videos released on this date in past years, with configurable memory count and look-back period.

Show every video from each selected anniversary year in the On This Day dashboard widget. Feature a video with a filmstrip of the rest, show year counts and previews, and open the full date-filtered list when more videos are available.

name: On This Day
description: A home dashboard widget that brings back videos released on today's date in past years.
author: MidnightRider
